notes.title: Pygmalion Patch 0.3.0v
notes.notes:
Hello Core Researchers!

We're excited to announce the Spring Sale and the Spring Theme Skin Giveaway event here at Core Research Lab!

Until March 31st, when you log in, you'll be able to check out the lab members who've gone on a spring outing, and the spring-themed cores in flower shapes. (If you wish to change skins, you can do so in [u]Extra > Custom[/u]!)

[b]Additional Content Details[/b]

- Title changes to fit the spring theme
- Addition of skins suitable for spring theme (given for free upon logging in until March 31st)
- The newly added spring theme will automatically equip upon the first login after this update.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed an issue where there was no response when selecting a chapter simultaneously with the opening of a new chapter in the outgame.

[b]Level Design Changes[/b]

- Some puzzles have been altered.

[b]Other Changes[/b]

- Some changes to the Xmas Wreath skin.

notes.title: Pygmalion Patch 0.2.0v
notes.notes:
Hello Core Researchers!

Even during the upcoming Christmas season, the research of graduate students will continue... 😱

But don't be dismayed! We have prepared a reward for all our researchers! 🎁

With this latest update, you can get a Christmas-themed skin.
(You can change it in [u]Extra > Customization[/u])


[b]Additional Content[/b]

- Titles are now winter-themed.
- Added skins suitable for the winter theme (free until December 31st upon logging in).

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed the issue where the 'StarryNight' skin was not unlocked despite unlocking the 'Coins!!!' achievement.
- Automatically grants 'StarryNight' to those who did not obtain it previously.
- Fixed the issue where Steam achievements were not clearing in-game challenges correctly.
- Fixed the issue of the game resetting.

[b]Level Design Changes[/b]

- Adjusted the puzzle completion requirements to match the intended number of moves for certain puzzles.
- Reduced the difficulty of puzzles in Story Mode.
- Some puzzles have been changed.

[b]Story Changes[/b]

- Slightly modified the automatic line breaks.
- Improved the flow of the story lines.

notes.title: Pygmalion Patch 0.1.9v
notes.notes:
Bug fix
- Addressed the issue of Twitch integration not working.

Puzzle changes

notes.title: Pygmalion Patch 0.1.8v
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

- Addressed the runtime error issue preventing the game from running on certain Windows systems.
- Fixed the issue where dialogue conclusions during story progression were displayed with a cursor icon instead of the correct mouse cursor.
- Resolved the problem where the game failed to read Twitch ID values.
- Corrected the cursor direction inconsistency when navigating with keyboard inputs.
- Fixed the abnormal cursor movement on the title screen.

Additional Changes

- Implemented a 3-second command disablement after puzzle manipulation, considering Twitch broadcast delay.
- If the time display option is deactivated, it will also be disabled in the results screen.

notes.title: Pygmalion Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hello. This is always-open game company, CandLE.

We are pleased to announce the release of the Pigmalion puzzle game that we have developed.
You can now play the Pigmalion Early Access version on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/cdbd284c56391cbb2885f45d42a82847691507e5.gif[/img]

You can experience a total of 480 puzzle stages, including an expanded story and puzzle mode, compared to the demo version. In the added episodes, you will need to research new devices such as additional colors, color separation tiles, and more.

Can you solve all the research tasks we've prepared?

You can also use the coins obtained as research rewards to purchase various skins. We recommend decorating the map according to your taste.

Pigmalion is still in the early access stage, and we are planning various additional contents such as Episode 3 story, daily puzzles, map customizations, and more.

Please look forward to the development of Pigmalion in the future, and we will reflect various feedback to show a better appearance. If you find any inconveniences, improvements, or bugs during the game, please contact us through Discord channels or discussion forums, and we will try to improve them as soon as possible.

Thank you to all users who show interest.

CandLE is always open. 🕯️

notes.title: Pygmalion Demo Update (Sep 28, 2023)
notes.notes:
- Some bug fixes have been implemented.

UI layer order has been changed.
The issue where UI colors did not change when the color was modified has been resolved.

- Voiceovers have been added to the characters.

Protagonist: CV (Character Voice) - Voice Actor: Lim Ha Muk
Selena: CV - Voice Actor: Lim Seung Mi
AI Prototype: CV - Voice Actor: Jung Yoo Jung
(If you can't hear the voice, try adjusting the sound settings in the settings menu.)

- Mouse sensitivity settings have been adjusted for improved accuracy.

For users using the existing mouse, it is recommended to change the sensitivity setting from "High" to "Medium" in "Settings > Controls > Sensitivity."

- Story translations have been revised.

Translations have been made more natural, reducing awkwardness.
(For feedback or if you have concerns about the translations, please contact us on Discord.)

- Cinematic enhancements have been added.

notes.title: Pygmalion Demo Update (September 8th, 2023)
notes.notes:
[b]Story modification and additional scenes in puzzle[/b]

To enhance the integration between puzzles and the story, a new storyline has been introduced. Additionally, storytelling and guidance within puzzle gameplay have been added to explain puzzle mechanics and rules.


[b]Background change[/b]

The background image has been replaced with a new one.


[b]Puzzle difficulty adjustment[/b]

Many users found the early stages of the puzzles, especially in story mode, to be too easy. As a result, the overall puzzle difficulty has been slightly increased. (Stages that have already been cleared will remain marked as cleared.)


[b]UI modification and addition of detailed functions[/b]

Now, when you select a button, the button will be highlighted.
The UI with language-specific translations has been applied.
The volume control button has been modified to a bar-shaped one for more precise volume control.
(We plan to separate character voices and sound effects in the future)
You can now turn off the in-game timer.
Various minor bugs have been fixed.
